summary.answer: Lazily builds and caches StatsBasedUnlockId once: outfit loot-ID aliases, hashed overrides, linked IDs, Warzone-character storage paths and deferred locked/unlocked/unlockable functions, then six fixed unlocked-tag entries with always-false itemUnlockable closures. Optional ZombiesCallings addition is dvar- and namespace-gated. Returns the cached table by identity; closures are not invoked while constructing it. Returns the two-value applicability/ownership result from the direct loot map, else the entitlement map. The latter subtracts deluxe-pack quantity when positive, entitlement absent and fakeall false. Unknown entries return false,false. For a matching hashed entry, reads ordinary and linked-ID quantities; subtracts the second when positive, entitlement absent and fakeall false. Returns entitlement-reference-present and adjusted-count-positive. No matching entry returns false,false. Looks up bundle by namehash, then mapped entitlement/deluxe data. A positive deluxe pack without entitlement and without fakeall reduces ordinary quantity by one. Returns entitlement-present and adjusted ownership; no mapped bundle returns false,false. Searches contract-table names and first matching row. Computes loot ownership and contract fallback, availability, event/purchasable flags and nonbase-weapon early override. Normalizes set hash0 to nil and chooses distinct event/owned/available/in-set unlock text before returning metadata. No row returns nil. The recovered numeric loop explicitly starts at1, ends at #f49_local12, and steps by1; original VM/provider behavior remains unproved. Searches seasons for the requested season number and first matching table row; ownership or current-season membership determines availability. Nonbase-weapon metadata may return early. Converts set hash0 to nil, chooses owned/available/in-set text, and returns tier/season/item metadata; otherwise nil. Searches rows then FindCorrectRow with the supplied weapon reference. Ownership alone initializes availability; a nonbase override returns early. Resolves set and owned/not-available text, then returns metadata; failed row selection returns nil. Walks matching bundle rows, requests bundle info and replaces its rarity when available. Returns immediately for owned=true; otherwise returns the last candidate or nil. No purchase is performed. Uses first matching item-shop row; ownership initializes availability. A recovered slot loop compares configured item hashes to set forSale. Set hash0 becomes nil; owned/in-set text and metadata are returned, otherwise nil. The recovered slot loop explicitly starts at1, ends at CoD.BlackMarketUtility.ItemShopSlots, and steps by1; the effective external slot-count value remains unknown. Uses the first bonus row, normalizes set hash0 to nil, gets owned/available states from GetBonusSetUnlockedAvailableStates and returns SETBONUS metadata with setMaster=true; no row returns nil. Uses first backfill row and returns rarity,isLoot=true, lootType EMPTY plus two separate reads of the same owned/available dvar. The recovered else arm is empty and falls through with no values, not an explicit false result.
